species.name: Lake trout
why: Water 49°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 8–38 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Trout
why: Water 49°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 8–20 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Northern pike
why: Water 49°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 1–18 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Smallmouth bass
why: Water 49°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 4–26 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
